response.sql: WITH tallies AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.throws, ''), 'missing') AS hand, COUNT(*) AS tally FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY 1), shares AS (SELECT hand, tally, 1.0 * tally / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM tallies), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_s FROM shares), above AS (SELECT s.hand, s.tally, s.share FROM shares s JOIN avg_share a ON s.share > a.avg_s) SELECT SUM(above.tally) AS combined_tally, AVG(above.share) AS avg_share, AVG(above.share - a.avg_s) AS avg_excess_share FROM above CROSS JOIN avg_share a;
